agent_notes: The NIRF Agriculture and Overall 2025 pages directly list the assigned institution name with Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh.

The official site verifies the institution at Kumarganj, Ayodhya. The catalogue's Azamgarh-campus agriculture row is retained verbatim as a university programme and is not used as the verified campus address.

The dedicated Degree Programme PDF lists the displayed undergraduate, master's, and Ph.D. programmes. Its numbering skips item 10; all displayed programme rows were transcribed without inventing a missing item.

The separate official Academic Programs page currently embeds an unrelated anti-ragging PDF; the dedicated Degree Programme PDF and current 2026 Diploma/Certificate brochure supply the catalogue used here.

Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy self-signed-certificate-in-chain error. curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to the expected NIRF, search-engine, and ndaut.org hosts after hostname confirmation.
